case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

You asked for a price that reflects your copper and labour costs. Our options answer this with what a group like yours values most: a binding volume over a longer contract term, with a unit price close to what we have paid so far.

On our purchase price history:
Our orders of Frequency converter 7.5 kW, IP55 with you were placed at EUR 414.61 on 2024-10-14 (po:4500011548-10), EUR 400.19 on 2025-06-30 (po:4500012634-10), EUR 412.74 on 2026-01-27 (po:4500013491-10) and EUR 412.74 on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014465-10): the price has not risen.

On delivery:
Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 414.58; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 415.97; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn a binding volume for a longer term, and the price sits in line with our recent orders.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, here is a paragraph you can forward unchanged: Hollerau Pumpenwerke offers a binding annual volume for the 7.5 kW frequency converter over a longer contract term, at a unit price in line with its recent orders and with a payment term that is clearly set out. This gives Selvbrunn a planable, committed volume and a straightforward decision on the terms of Option A.

Please take Option A to your approver. If the committee needs anything more from us to decide, tell me what it requires and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
messages.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your e-mail, which we have reviewed internally.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €431.77 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For your information:
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
As to the delivery record and price history data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We have reviewed your proposed Option A and verified the price history from your previous orders.
In response to your commitment to a 24-month contract term, we can reduce our price to EUR 429.58 per unit.
This revised offer reflects a fair balance between your requested terms and our current operational parameters.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €429.58 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2611, LCI-C, CU-NOTATION.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Legal Department: Please note that our general terms and conditions apply to this process; furthermore, the quote lists our standard terms.

messages.body:

You said that talks on terms are possible while price reductions are frozen. Our options do exactly that: they give you a binding volume over a longer contract term, with payment terms you can choose from.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 421.26; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option B: unit price EUR 418.79; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.
Option C: unit price EUR 417.56; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; binding volume 4,580 units per year.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives Selvbrunn the longest payment term alongside the binding volume and the contract term you have already named. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Here is a short paragraph you can forward unchanged to your pricing committee:

Hollerau Pumpenwerke offers a binding annual volume for the frequency converter over a longer contract term, with a fixed unit price and a defined payment term. This gives Selvbrunn planning security on volume and a clear framework for the whole term. We ask the committee to approve Option A as it stands.

Please take Option A to your approver. If the committee needs anything further to decide, tell us and we will provide it.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
